# volcano_project_schedulers (Data Source)

Every scheduler across every function and durable function in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_project_schedulers" "example" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `schedulers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedulers))

### Nested Schema for `schedulers`

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `next_run_at` (String)
